groups.why_chosen: One primitive-level dataflow graph, colour-coded by operation type, gets a second independent overlay — dashed purple boxes labelled Pass N — marking exactly which subgraph each optimizer rewrite touched.
groups.what_to_learn: Keep one fixed colour per primitive type across the graph, overlay a second layer of dashed pass-labelled boxes to narrate which rewrite touched which subgraph — but repeating the same Pass-3 label three times leaves 'why the same pass' unanswered.
